name: insights
description: How you really work with Claude Code, rebuilt from the files it keeps on your machine: sessions and helpers, what the agent knows before it starts, how you hand work over, check it and correct it, what you built for yourself. /insights:my-agentic-setup writes a private page for you, a second one that suggests your level (1-4) from what you built, not what you installed, and only on your yes a masked report you can choose to share.
